name: Abide
reason: Condition-led marketing, as with Breethe: abide.com (a division of Guideposts; robots.txt allows us) titles itself 'Sleep Meditation Bible', leads its home page with user-survey claims of improvement in depression, insomnia and stress, routes visitors by Anxiety, Grief, Sleep and Stress, and its 'Why Meditate?' page leads with mental and physical health benefits. The underlying content is biblical meditation and audio Bible (Yearly $39.99/yr offer, Monthly $9.99/mo on its home page; help form at help.abide.com), so the owner may revisit on Calm-style practice-only terms.
